views.name: customer_esim_orders
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    user_id,
    provider,
    bundle_name,
    quantity,
    retail_price_usd,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    total_amount_usd,
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'failed'::text) THEN 'eSIM order could not be completed.'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS error_message,
    delivery_state
   FROM esim_orders;

views.name: customer_esim_profiles
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    user_id,
    order_id,
    iccid,
        CASE
            WHEN (supplier_profile_ref IS NOT NULL) THEN lpa_string
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS lpa_string,
    qr_code_url,
    bundle_name,
    provider,
    status,
    purchased_at,
    data_total_mb,
    data_remaining_mb,
    last_usage_check,
    profile_state,
    installation_state,
    bundle_state,
    activation_trigger,
    first_activated_at,
    confirmed_expires_at AS expires_at,
    activation_deadline_at,
    data_total_bytes,
    data_used_bytes,
    data_remaining_bytes,
    usage_observed_at,
    last_observation_at,
    last_usage_attempt_at,
    usage_error_code,
    plan_details AS catalogue_details,
    (supplier_profile_ref IS NOT NULL) AS issuance_verified
   FROM user_esims
  WHERE (user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid));
